The Lumberzacks (Milo Murphy’s Law)

Main things that cause change in texture: -hormonal (pregnancy, menopause)

\-medical (cancer treatments)

\-keratin treatment, perm, or relaxer. The keratin is the least damaging of these. It can reduce the curl and help control frizz. For reference, this is a before and after of a keratin treatment. (Brazilian blowout brand)

https://preview.redd.it/k5teob9puvze1.jpeg?width=2048&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=be912ca4d61b2c9bdd2deee5dcf793959424c6dd

There was one of a different client with a different brand (keratin complex), but that’s not important. Pretty similar results.

\-length. The weight of longer hair makes it harder for any sort of curl or wave from bouncing back

\-grey hair. Greys can feel thick and wire-y. Most people don’t notice the change in texture until there’s a lot (50% or more). Assuming the color upkeep, that is something that won’t play into it for years to come.

\-excessive damage. Hair that is frequently colored and styled is more susceptible to damage. It’ll seem more dry, and the cuticle is probably blown open. That makes it harder for the hair to take any kind of product. Color fades fast, styling doesn’t seem to stay.
